description: Private, read-only capacity check-in. Keeps private blockers private and emits only coarse available/reduced/unavailable for a shared work graph. It is never fitness-for-duty and never exposes health reasons to an employer or public board. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.

desiredFocus.description: Optional. The one thing the person wants to work on next, plain words, up to 500 characters. Kept private. Example: "Get the referral scheduled".

privateBlockers.description: Optional. What is in the way, in the person's own words, one short phrase each, at most 12 kept. Kept private: never returned and never shared. Example: ["no ride on Tuesdays"].

safetySignal.description: Optional, none when left out. Only pass a stronger signal when the person or context explicitly supports it; never infer one from vague distress. Any value other than none returns the route to a qualified human in the escalation field. Example: "none".

selfReportedCapacity.description: The person's own report of their capacity now. Never infer it. The shared signal is coarse: available is available, reduced and recovery_needed are reduced, paused is unavailable. Example: "reduced".

name: capacity_checkin
title: Project private human capacity into a minimal work-availability signal
